label: SOC 2
scope_note: Internal Type 2 readiness. Security/Common Criteria are the starting scope; optional categories require a client choice. Management designs the controls. Evidence, operating periods and internal conclusions are not a CPA audit or attestation opinion.

requirements.title: Ethical conduct
requirements.source_cadence: Management defines control frequency based on system commitments and risks; no universal quarterly or annual mandate.
requirements.guidance: Omnisciente readiness prompt: describe management-designed controls for ethical conduct. Identify the system commitments, boundary and relevant risks. Evaluate design separately from evidence of operation during the stated period.
requirements.evidence_guidance: Suggested support: control description, configuration or procedure, dated operating records, population definition and internal testing notes. Management-entered counts do not prescribe auditor sampling.
